_help: Hand corrections for 'one coin per big city' (used by 3-build.mjs). officialOnly: GeoNames ids of cities that keep only their official boundary (they never take in neighbouring communities). keepSeparate: GeoNames ids that must keep their own coin. merge: { childId: parentId } to force a place into a bigger city's coin. Ids are the numbers in public/data/cities.json.

_why.5101717: New Brunswick keeps its own coin, as before New York City stopped taking in Edison (2026-09-28).
_why.5124276: Levittown (NY) keeps its own coin rather than joining Hempstead, as the user approved (2026-09-28).
_why.5128581: New York City: the five boroughs only, so Newark, Jersey City, Yonkers and the rest don't see their city merged into NYC (decided 2026-09-28).
